Replacement = **adaptive fan-out** (policy §12.2), not a fixed ceiling — encoded as `[concurrency] default_active=1, hard_ceiling=2` in `config/orchestration.toml`, with guard verified tool-only (no hardcoded 2 in `orchestrator-guard.ts`).

Four bounding dimensions: (1) conservative default (1 active), (2) config/env max — `SECOND_BRAIN_CONCURRENCY_CEILING`, (3) a hard resource ceiling, (4) telemetry (`fan_out_width`) recording actual width.

Live campaign proof: width 2 used only when justified (Phase A+B, verifier+build concurrent); depth bounded separately by daemon `RLM_MAX_DEPTH=1`.
